pages.text: All dusts in this chapter are produced by the Akaishi Pulverizer, with one exception: Akaishi Ore fed to the Pulverizer yields Compressed Akaishi Essence (1 ore → 1), and pulverizing that concentrate yields ×2 Akaishi Dust. All other ores are processed directly from ore to dust. Downstream, the Compressor presses dust back into blocks and the Transformer converts it into bases.$(br2)To begin, install a power grid and one Pulverizer; it accepts normal and deepslate ores, Akaishi Ore and Obsidian.

$(bold)Complete dust list:$(reset)$(li)Akaishi Dust: pulverized from Compressed Akaishi Essence (1 → 2); 9 press into 1 Akaishi Essence$(li)Compressed Akaishi Essence: 1 Akaishi Ore pulverizes into 1, or 9 Akaishi Dust convert to 1 in the Transformer$(li)Coal Dust: 9 press into 1 Coal Block$(li)Iron Dust / Gold Dust: 9 press into the matching block$(li)Copper Dust: 9 press into 1 Copper Block$(li)Lapis Dust: 9 press into 1 Lapis Block, or 1 converts into a Cooling Base$(li)Diamond Dust / Emerald Dust: 9 press into the matching block$(li)Quartz Dust: 9 press into 1 Quartz Block$(li)Netherite Dust: 9 press into 1 Netherite Ingot$(li)Obsidian Dust: 4 press into 1 Obsidian$(br2)For pressing details, see the Compressor; feed the Pulverizer the ore matching the required dust.

Dust is made by the $(l:akaishi:pulverizer)Pulverizer$(/l) and consumed by the $(l:akaishi:compressor)Compressor$(/l); for the process from mineral to metal, read $(l:akaishi:ingot)Akaishi Ingot$(/l).
